messages:
Aisha (CSM): Heads-up — NovaPay QBR is booked for Tue 11am PT. Need owners for slides, a short risk summary for renewal, and a fast way to capture exec feedback.
Jon (AE): I can confirm their execs: CFO + Head of Payments. We'll want a 5-min cost/ROI slide.
Diego (CS Ops): Slide deck link -> https://redwood.share/nova-qbr-v1 (I've added a notes page). Can someone drop metrics for active usage & latency impact?
Lina (CSM Manager): Renewal flagged as 'watch' — usage up 12% but sticky features low. Add an adoption vs expected table. I'll write the renewal risk bullet.
Samira (Enablement): I can take the demo + training snippet slide. I'll also capture top 3 customer asks to hand to enablement for a 15-min playbook.
Aisha (CSM): Quick owners list (please ack): 1) Exec summary - Aisha; 2) ROI/cost - Jon; 3) Adoption metrics - Diego; 4) Risk + renewal ask - Lina; 5) Demo + playbook - Samira.
Jon (AE): Ack. I'll also include contract/term timeline.
Diego (CS Ops): Ack. I'll paste two charts (DAU, avg tokens/day) into the deck by Fri EOD.
Lina (CSM Manager): I'll draft the renewal ask + proposed discount/commit options. Want to surface any support escalations?
Aisha (CSM): There's one support thread re: private deployment latency from last month — call it out briefly.
Samira (Enablement): For feedback capture — propose a 3-question exec poll after the QBR (1-3 scale): satisfaction, likelihood to expand, blockers. I can build a Google form and a short follow-up email template.
Diego (CS Ops): +1. Also suggest we record the runbook for the demo fallback (if model latency spikes use model-b fallback). I'll add the snippet: `if latency > 800ms -> route to model-b`
QBR-bot: Calendar invite created for Tue 11am PT. Guests: NovaPay execs, Aisha, Jon, Lina, Samira.
Aisha (CSM): Action items recap — slides due Fri 5pm, dry run Mon 9am, feedback form live within 24h after QBR, deck to execs 1hr before meeting. Assignments above. Anyone with blockers?
Jon (AE): Need finance numbers from NovaPay — I'll chase and update slide by Thu.
Lina (CSM Manager): No blockers. I'll prep the renewal options and rehearse the ask during dry run.
Samira (Enablement): I'll prepare the playbook snippet and the 90-sec demo script.
Diego (CS Ops): Will upload charts by Thu EOD, then final deck Friday.
Aisha (CSM): Great. I'll consolidate slides on Fri and send final to the group. :thumbsup: 
Jon (AE): Thanks — tagging @Aisha when I drop the finance figures.
Samira (Enablement): Also recommend we include a quick customer quote slide (ops impact). Anyone have a short blurb?
Lina (CSM Manager): I'll pull a quote from the onboarding notes and drop it in.
Aisha (CSM): Perfect — thanks team. I'll run the dry run agenda (5m exec summary / 10m demo / 10m adoption & ask / 5m Qs) and share with you all.
Diego (CS Ops): Noted. I'll confirm recording + runbook link before dry run.
Aisha (CSM): Closing — slides owned, runbook, and feedback plan in place. We'll reconvene Fri if needed.
